### 'Erase Entire...': Bukele's Hellish Attack On Haiti Gangs; Trump Bolsters El Salvador's Military Op

El Salvador has deployed at least 2,500 troops to Haiti as President Nayib Bukele expands his campaign against the country's powerful gangs. Initially launched after four Salvadoran military personnel went missing in a gang ambush, the operation has grown into a major military offensive, with Salvadoran forces targeting gang strongholds in Port-au-Prince. Bukele's intervention has received Donald Trump's backing, with the US president reportedly telling him, “Do what you have to do.” But questions are mounting over Washington's role, the operation's command structure and the risks of another foreign intervention in Haiti. The latest development: Haiti's Prime Minister is expected to visit El Salvador to discuss the future of the deployment, as a diplomatic dispute between Bukele's government and US officials exposes tensions over how the mission is being conducted.
